reviews.comment: INCREDIBLE. She is extremely knowledgeable and asks thought-provoking questions. She moved me to tears many times. Tests are online, outside of class, and not honor-lock (not hard if you read and go to class). Tested mostly on her lectures and the primary source documents from the textbook. Best professor ever, her passion is palpable.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hudson was very kind, thoughtful, and concise. Her lectures are very interesting to listen to and well thought out. The only grades are the quizzes and exams, but as long as you read the textbook they're not too bad. The textbook sections are long, but it'll be worth the read. Very interesting content.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Respected

reviews.comment: This class was so easy. Attendance wasn't mandatory but I made sure to go to class because most of the content in the lectures was on the quizzes and tests. If you take good notes you should do well!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Caring--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very informative professor. Gave three at home tests, 50 questions and an essay. Couldn't go back to previous questions in the tests. Gave an open window for the tests. Go to lectures since the material in lecture is heavy in tests. She takes attendance and gives extra credit. Didn't post lecture slides. She is very nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor, great class! Hudson is clearly passionate about what she's teaching. Definitely go to class and take notes. Most of your grade comes from multiple choice tests and document based essays. You don't need to buy the textbook. I didn't. Evans has a copy you can check out for the exams, and she lectures over all the content.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hudson was an awesome professor. Her lectures were always interesting and she is such a nice person. There was an assigned textbook, but I didn't do the readings. There are questions that can only be found by going to lectures/doing the reading, so I highly recommend doing both (even if it is just skimming the texts).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very passionate and learned a lot from her. Go to class if you can because material that is not in the book will be covered. Questions on quizzes and tests are very specific so take good notes and read the textbook carefully, especially the documents. 12 quizzes total and 3 exams, all closed note. Harder than I thought but interesting overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: MUST go to lecture AND read the textbook. Quizzes/tests are hard because questions must be answered within ~a minute before you go to the next - can't jump between questions or change the answer after you leave it so there's not much time to think. Plus there are questions referring to specific images in a certain chapter but it's all closed note.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hudson is hands down my FAVORITE professor. She is well-versed in her words and comes very prepared for her lectures. I could honestly listen to her talk for hours because her lectures are SO interesting and it's like listening to a thought-provoking story every class. The class changes your perspective and reveals what we aren't taught.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: You MUST go to class even if it is not required! Her lectures could be completely different from the textbook readings that week, but Professor Hudson is so passionate. Her lectures are interesting and she's great about answering any questions people may have in class. Your grade relies on the three online exams only that do have essay portions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Respected--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hudson loves making you talk in class but actually wants to have a conversation about the material. Tests are ID questions and short answer/ essay question (normal history format). Exams reflected what we learned in class but you definitely need to read - a big essay at end of class about readings. And accommodating if you have issues come up
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: 10 quizzes, 3 exams, and a final essay. Not terribly hard, but does require at least reading the textbook. Attendance is  counted but not mandatory. Interesting lectures, she genuinely cared about the subject, and we had 2 extra credit opportunities.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Remember to pay attention to her lectures, documents, and the keywords (words in bold) in the textbook. I would say that the class is difficult, definitely not an easy A. There are only 3 exams (not open-note) and all of them are on Canvas. She does have quizzes each week and offers extra-credit to replace lower quiz grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loves this prof Hudson. She's really nice and it is obvious she's very passionate and knowledgeable. the lecture and content of the class were very interesting. definitely read the primary documents in the textbook, but if you go to class you don't need to read the chapters, so go to class. thought the quiz questions and exams were pretty easy.

Class was heavily group work, get ready to make forced acquaintances as she made us split into groups at least once a week. Lecture heavy, little on slides, most info straight from mouth. Type or write fast, she does not slow down. Often in class discussions, engages with students at this level. Be specific in all answers
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Subject is interesting but the class was dull.  Dr. Hudson knows the subject well.  Not a bad class but not a great class.  Lots of reading.  Easy B but A is very possible if you keep up and study.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall a great class, lectures are a little boring but that's any history class. Reading the book isn't exactly necessary, but I would; especially the documents(quiz and test questions on them) Always quick to respond to emails, will reopen missed assignments, offers extra credit and actually has a personality during zooms. Would take her again
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's a nice lady, but I found myself falling asleep for 90% of her lectures. There is also a text book that she tests from, but I got an A without really reading it except for the required documents for essays. Also, very sparse feedback on the essays that doesn't really help.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Everyone should be required to take this class!! Its AMAZING content and the professor really cares and makes you care. I loved this class even though it was a lot of reading a lectures, its one of the most memorable classes I took. I would go back just to learn more shes awesome.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's truly an incredible professor who cares about the students and the subject matter. However, this class is not an easy A. There is a lot of time-consuming reading that you have to do in order to get a good grade. Lectures can feel very long and many people had a hard time focusing because of the amount of information given in a class period.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS. I learned so much about American Indian history that I never learned in high school. Dr. Hudson is very passionate about this topic and that made lectures engaging. She cares about her students, grades fairly, and offered 2 extra credit opportunities. I'm so glad I took her class - she's one of my fav professors I had at TAMU.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Hudson is very passionate about the subject she teaches and loves to answer questions. She is easy to reach outside of class, and is willing to help you with your grade. Her tests are take home essays as well as an in class multiple choice so you get to work on it for a few days, which makes it easier to get a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Hudson is obviously very passionate for the subject and makes it interesting. She genuinely cares about the students learning the material and doing well. All of the assignments and exams were well written and fairly graded but reading and studying the textbook is mandatory if you want a good grade. I wish she taught more classes though.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This course was amazing and eye opening. Dr. Hudson comes off tough at first, but she really cares about the subject matter and is very caring towards the students. There were plenty of extra credit opportunities and she's available for clarifying questions before and after class. Significantly better than typical US history.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lecture is very clear and interesting and she is passionate. The multiple choice exam is easy. The only problem was with the essay. She said if you fulfil all the requirements in the essay secrion you get full points but thats not the case. The TA grades them very hard and some feeebacks are very non intuitive. I got a B for 89. 3 prcnt. no curve.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Hudson is amazing! She's passionate about the class and makes lectures enjoyable. Everything she says is on the exam, so not showing up hurts you. If you do the required readings, the exams will not be tough at all. Essays aren't bad either if you read the assigned readings and showed up to class. I loved her class!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Hudson is very passionate about this subject and it is what makes her great. I really enjoyed her lectures. You do have to take good notes because she doesn't post any and you also cannot use laptops in her class. READ THE BOOK! The chapters are long but do it. Test are 50 mult. choice and there are essays for each. No cumulative final.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her class was informative and interesting. But her grading criteria is VERY unclear and all over the place. She does give good feedback but don't expect a good grade even if you are a good writer. I worked harder here than I have before in any class and still only made it out with a C. This class broke my 4.0 in my Senior year.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: You definitely have to read a lot. You get a lot from her class but you have to earn that A. With her exams it's half multiple choice and have take home essay. The multiple choice is easy as long as you read but she's a tough grader when it comes to the essays. She gives extra credit. She's really strict about attendance though.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Hudson is a great professor. She is very passionate about Native American history and she always make lectures interesting with photos and music that pertain to the lecture. She is always organized and makes it clear what material we will need to know. This is in no way an easy A class. Essay intensive, detailed exams, and pop quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: While Dr. Hudson is very knowledgeable in her area, her class is very difficult. Lectures are long and there is a ton of reading. The essay portion of her tests are due 48 hrs after the test and graded very, very hard. Super fast paced course and very difficult exams. Don't skip class-ever.

Dr. Hudson is very knowledgeable about her field, and will answer any questions about the lecture material. She is also very sweet. This is not a blow off class, there is a LOT of reading. Exams are difficult if you don't read, 50 mc & a take home essay. She gives pop quizzes so be prepared. Loved her and the class. Taking her HIST 280 in the fall.

No electronics, including computers :( Lectures are interesting though. 3 Exams, 1/2 multiple choice, 1/2 take-home essay. Reading the book isn't really NECESSARY as long as you take good notes, you'll miss a few questions but not many. And if you do skip class, I suggest reading the chapter that she covered that week.

Professor Hudson gives long lectures, however, the material is very interesting and she plays music pertaining to the subject in the beginning of class. She does give the occasional pop clicker quiz on the reading assigned for the week. The chapters in the text are long but informational.

Dr. Hudson is the most passionate professor I've had at TAMU. Although the class was MWF, it was never a struggle to attend on Friday. She sparked my interest in the subject through her 258 class, and I actually wanted to go to class. 3 300 page books, 4 hours a week to read the required reading. Attendance/participation required. Not a blow off.

I took Hudson for a class of about 25 people. There were about 80-100 pages of reading every week with a homework assignment due on Fridays. She is extremely passionate and knowledgeable about Indian studies. Reading is MANDATORY if you want a good grade, but the readings are very interesting. She is also a great discussion facilitator.

Honestly, I really enjoyed this class. I think she is a great professor who is pretty passionate about what she is teaching. She had 3 tests and then 12 pop quizzes (where she dropped your 2 lowest grades). She took attendance everyday.  It is so so so important to read all of the material in the textbook from start to finish.

Lectures are long and boring. The tests are alright but the essay part of the tests are graded very tough. They will count off for the smallest things.  I would avoid her as a prof. She takes attendance and there are pop quizzes.
It is not impossible to make an A as long as you put forth the effort.

I think Ms. Hudson is a great professor. She is very knowledgable in the subject of indigenous history. I loved going to her class. As for the notes, take a lot of them. Also, read the book, (the chp. & documents) Clicker quizzes  weekly. Tests: 50% Multiple choice, 50% take home essay. I would recommend Hudson if you're interested in history.

Hudson is a horrible prof, she speaks extremely fast, I normally only got about 75% of the information I intended to write down. There are three tests that are each 50 multiple choice questions & the other half of the test is a take home essay. Our take home essay for the second test was due Easter weekend. Rude & difficult. Would not take again.

Has an English Major I believe so she expects perfect papers also they are usally due with in  2 days. Exams are not to bad but you do have to study over all a pretty intersitng class definatly the hardest history course I have ever taken.

Dr. Hudson is great! Her tests are pretty easy. She does a 50 question multiple choice section and the she has you write an 700-900 word essay on a given topic. The reading is mandatory because she does clicker questions off the readings at least once a week. She made the class easy to understand.
